value.rationale: The natural seven-dimensional cubic harmonic observation problem has a known 4D blind subspace for point samples on the smallest Platonic 5-design. It is useful to know which positive-area cap mixtures eliminate blind modes and balance all seven directions. The theorem classifies every positive aperture, finds two exact nonhemispherical Parseval apertures, a reentrant 4→3→4 worst-mode switch and the sharp small-cap instability; this is a natural complete concentration-frame invariant rather than arbitrary finite data.
